gen-eater-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav is modern and spacious, its lowercase rising nearly to the capitals while the letters huddle close. Yantramanav gives Eater's dark, aggressive display letters a sans-serif partner that stays out of the way over a long page.
gen-eater-space-grotesk: Eater leads with thin strokes against moderately weighty stems, which is where its dark bite comes from. And Space Grotesk does the quiet work, a sans-serif ribbon of constant width with counters that stay open.
gen-flavors-fs-amulya: Whimsical and bossy, Flavors looks drawn with a single nib and a towering lowercase. And Amulya keeps its sans curves generous and modern, so a longer stretch of text goes down smoothly.
gen-flavors-fs-plein: Flavors is a commanding, playful display face with towering lowercase. Plein sits underneath as a reliable sans with a clear channel into each round letter, so the two share a page without crowding each other.
gen-flavors-gf-aclonica: Aclonica stretches out in wide, long lines with a deep midsection, a sans-serif with a stroke shift you feel more than see. Flavors does the shouting with whimsy; Aclonica does the steady talking.
gen-flavors-gf-allerta: Flavors is whimsical and commanding, with no swelling in its outlines. Allerta, a sans-serif with wide, loose tracking and a prominent x-height, lets a long page of text unspool without feeling cramped.
gen-flavors-gf-arsenal: Arsenal keeps its lowercase close to cap height and its letters knit tightly, a plain sans with a modest weight shift. Flavors brings the whimsy in one uniform stroke, while Arsenal handles the reading.
gen-flavors-gf-asimovian: Asimovian builds each lowercase letter large and from a single stroke width, approachable as a plain sans. Flavors above it adds the whimsy, and paragraphs stay easy to follow.
gen-flavors-gf-carlito: Whimsical Flavors comes in with wire-like, tubular letters. Carlito follows as a modern sans with open round shapes, tight spacing, and small capitals beside big lowercase, which gives the display type room to perform.
gen-flavors-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime is a precise monospace with lowercase filling most of its height. Its strongest quality is that drafting-pen steadiness, a structured counterweight to the whimsical, commanding Flavors above it.
